text:
Opinions are divided as to whether public money should be directed mainly at mental health or at physical health. This essay will consider both perspectives before explaining my own opinion.

On the one hand, supporters of mental health spending argue that mental illness is common but often neglected. Conditions such as depression and anxiety are hidden, carry stigma and cost society through lost work, broken relationships and, in the worst cases, suicide. Early help is far cheaper than late treatment, yet many people wait months for therapy. An employee with untreated depression, for example, may be absent from work for months and strain relationships at home. Young people are especially at risk, and good support at school can prevent problems that last for decades. For these reasons, mental health deserves a larger share of spending than it usually receives.

On the other hand, critics point out that physical illness is often more visible and immediately life-threatening. Cancer, heart disease and injuries need hospitals, equipment and trained staff at once, and their results are easier to measure. A heart patient who cannot get an operation, for instance, may die within weeks, whatever else the government spends on. Mental health also tends to improve when physical needs are met, since people who are free from pain and disease are better able to cope. Funding for physical care therefore cannot be allowed to fall. Both forms of care are essential to a healthy society.

In conclusion, both views have merit. Personally, I believe that mental and physical health are closely connected and that mental health should receive a larger share than at present, while life-saving physical care remains well funded.

plan.think: Mở bài nêu hai đối tượng của đề (mental / physical health); mỗi thân bài một phía.
Bệnh tâm thần phổ biến nhưng bị bỏ quên, chi phí ẩn; điều trị sớm rẻ hơn; người trẻ dễ tổn thương. Ví dụ nhân viên trầm cảm không điều trị nghỉ việc hàng tháng.
Bệnh thể chất rõ và đe doạ tính mạng; cần bệnh viện, thiết bị, nhân lực ngay; kết quả đo được; tinh thần khá hơn khi thể chất ổn. Ví dụ bệnh nhân tim không mổ được.
Hai loại sức khoẻ gắn chặt; tâm thần nên nhận phần lớn hơn hiện nay, thể chất vẫn được tài trợ tốt.
